name: BCL2 like 1

function.text: BCL2L1 encodes bcl-2-like protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include channel activity and BH3 domain binding. It participates in apoptotic mitochondrial changes and regulation of cytokinesis.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: BCL2L1 lies in a recurrent focal amplification region in human cancers, with evidence that amplified tumor models depend on its anti-apoptotic activity. Copy-number gain should be distinguished from sequence mutation.
